names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 14431, «Димитрий (Касаткин), иерей, сщмч.», with the two rank words left off; the day line gives «Димитрия пресвитера» without the surname, and the surname is the index's.

death.note: The Russian day line, and the only thing printed about him besides his name and his rank: «Сщмч. Димитрия пресвитера (1942)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Димитрия пресвитера (1942).»
source.note: No rank is recorded: the line carries no service icon. The day's three icons all stand in the paragraph above it, each immediately before its own entry.

attestations.note: **The calendar prints a line and nothing else.** The day line gives the rank, the name and the year; his name page 14431 adds the surname, «Димитрий (Касаткин), иерей, сщмч.», and the second day he is kept on, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors — and then stops. There is no life link on the day line and no life on the name page. **azbyka.ru, which is the workable source for the twentieth-century new martyrs, refused the page**: it answered 403 to the corpus's own fetcher for `/days/2026-10-28` on 28 October 2026, and that is the day and the reason this folder is thin. The 26 January day was not read and no row is written for it. His index number, 14431, is among the highest on the day, where Simeon (Konyukhov)'s is 9796 and Athanasius (Sakharov)'s 9133 — the calendar's own numbering, recorded here only because it is how the two namesakes on this day are told apart.
